title: Minimum and Multiplicity
statement:
Use an iterative segment tree to support point assignments and queries for a range minimum and its frequency.

Input
n q, the n values, then q operations. SET i x replaces a[i]. MIN L R uses inclusive 1-based endpoints.

Output
Print the minimum value and how many times it appears for each MIN.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Each value has absolute value at most 10⁹. 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000. Assigned values have the same bounds.
